superlatives_note: Each entry is a REGEX SOURCE (case-insensitive), not a literal phrase. Sec.5 UWG bites on the SHAPE of an absolute-supremacy claim.

context_exemptions.reason: Third-party CREDENTIAL DETECTION. The label and env-var name must match the real credential type, or the scanner cannot tell the user what leaked and the pattern cannot match. Market context per BRANDING.md 2, never a statement of what INA runs on. The packaged bundle is listed too: the same strings survive webpack into the shipped artifact, where the whole file is a single line.

EGRESS POLICY and provider interoperability settings. Hostnames must be literal to be blockable, and a setting that lets the operator enable an external provider must name that provider or it is unusable. The packaged path extension/package.json is listed too: vsce relocates the manifest under extension/ inside the .vsix.

THIRD-PARTY SDK DEPENDENCY. The npm package name and the class it exports are wire identifiers: renaming them does not compile. Market context per BRANDING.md 2, never a statement of what INA runs on.

SELF-HOSTED PROVIDER INTEROPERABILITY. ModelProvider is the union an enterprise operator picks from when pointing their own deployment at their own inference endpoint. A setting that lets an operator select a provider cannot omit that provider's name and remain usable, and the value is persisted in enterprise configuration, so renaming the members would break stored deployments for a cosmetic gain. Market context per BRANDING.md 2 — a list of what INA can CONNECT TO, never a statement of what INA runs on.

exempt_paths_note: Files exempt BY DESIGN: LICENSE/NOTICE/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES (Apache-2.0 s.4 attribution); BRANDING.md and .brandmap.json (they ARE the rule and must list the forbidden terms); the linters and their negative proofs (a gate proof necessarily contains the terms it detects); src/config/model-registry.ts (BRANDING.md s.5 designates it the single sanctioned home for upstream ids).
vsix_id_baseline_note: HARD ZERO, measured 2026-09-11 against ina-coding-1.1.0.vsix with 665 of 673 files scanned. The previous value of 2 was measured while the artifact scan was skipping extension/dist/extension.js and the packaged webview bundle, because the repository's dist/ and out/ exemptions were being applied to the artifact. It therefore measured the manifest and a few docs, not the product. The two package.json setting defaults it did see are now INA model ids. Shrink-only.

surface_exemptions.reason: LEGAL DISCLOSURE. A subprocessor list, a DPA, an Impressum and a privacy policy must name the ACTUAL processors and legal entities. The duty arises from Art. 13(1)(e) GDPR (recipients or categories of recipients) and the transparency principle in Art. 5(1)(a); Art. 28(2) governs prior authorisation and notice of subprocessor changes, and Art. 28(4) governs the contractual flow-down, NOT the public disclosure itself. Suppressing a real subprocessor name to satisfy a branding preference is a transparency failure, and is the same class of error as stripping an Apache-2.0 attribution notice.

API INTEROPERABILITY. Developer documentation must name the client SDK a caller is expected to use; an OpenAI-compatible endpoint cannot be documented without the words OpenAI-compatible. Market context per BRANDING.md 2, never a statement of what INA runs on.
NEGATIVE COMPARATIVE. Naming a vendor in order to state that INA does NOT use it is the opposite of the claim this standard forbids, and removing the name would make the sentence unreadable.

id_baseline_note: HARD ZERO as of 2026-09-11. Measured down from 101 by moving upstream resolution server-side: the extension sends an INA id and the private API repository resolves it. There is no longer any sanctioned home for an upstream identifier in this repository, so the src/config/model-registry.ts file exemption was removed with the same commit rather than left standing as a hole.
build_output_note: Paths whose exemption is SOURCE-SCAN ONLY. In a repository scan these hold generated output that nobody reviews, so linting them is noise. In an ARTIFACT scan (--dir over an unpacked .vsix) the generated bundle IS the product, and exempting it means the artifact gate inspects the manifest and skips the 1.9 MB of compiled extension it exists to check. Measured 2026-09-11: the gate reported 11 of 673 files scanned and called the artifact clean. brand-lint therefore drops these exemptions when --dir is in force.
